name: 色収差分析
description: 検出します color fringing at high-コントラスト edges produced by real camera lenses. AI生成の images typically lack this optical アーティファクト since they dont simulate lens physics.
mechanism: 測定します color channel misalignment にわたる the image. Real camera lenses produce predictable radial chromatic aberration. AI images either lack this or produce physically implausible パターン.
parameters: Channel pairs: R-G, R-B, G-B, Measurement: phase 相関, Radial model: Brown-Conrady
accuracy: 中-高 - 75-85% when chromatic aberration is detectable
source: Johnson and Farid (2006), ACM Workshop on Multimedia and Security
useCase: Detecting absence or 不整合 of lens-induced chromatic aberration

references.title: Johnson, M.K. & Farid, H. (2006). Exposing Digital Forgeries Through Chromatic Aberration. ACM Workshop MMS.
Yerushalmy, I. & Hel-Or, H. (2011). Digital Image Forgery Detection Based on Lens and Sensor Aberration. IJCV.

strengths:
• Based on physical optics of real lenses
• AI generators rarely simulate lens physics
• Predictable radial パターン in real photos
• Strong 真正性 indicator when present
limitations:
• Not all real photos have detectable aberration
• High-quality lens corrections may remove traces
• Small or cropped images reduce 検出
• Some AI models are learning to add fake aberration
